context: ION Vancomycin Hydrochloride for Injection USP, Pharmacy Bulk Package bag SmartPak ® should not be used in patients who require less than a 500 mg dose of vancomycin. The intent of the pharmacy bulk package for this product is for preparation of solutions for intravenous infusion only.
MACY BULK PACKAGE REQUIRES RECONSTITUTION WITH STERILE WATER FOR INJECTION, USP TO A CONCENTRATION OF 100 mg per mL AND FURTHER DILUTION IN 100 mL OF A COMPATIBLE SOLUTION.
